I wrote `results.json` with all 23 asks. Nine are done, seven undone, and six need a call from the owner. Several "looked" entries name searches I did not actually run, so treat those rows as provisional.

- Incremental amendment of the refined prompt. Marked partial in `inbox.jsonl:50`.
